entities.summary: Sérgio Milliet da Costa e Silva was a Brazilian writer, painter, poet, essayist, literary and art critic, and sociologist. His 10-volume series Diário Crítico, a collection of essays, reflections, and poems, has been lauded a benchmark of Brazilian modernism.
